description: Profiles the token's creator wallet: how much history it has, how much of the supply the creator still holds, and whether ownership is renounced — rolled into a 0-100 reputation score with signals. A fresh wallet holding 20% of supply with no renounce is the classic rug setup; this is the forensics layer other checks skip.
